title: 雅思·全球联系与地方发展 · 64 句
description: 贸易、供应链、人才迁移、语言交流、旅游、国际规则、援助与地方影响。

items.zh: 贸易能扩大选择，也会改变本地企业面对的竞争。
items.en: Trade expands choice while changing competition for local firms.
answers: Trade expands choice while changing competition for local firms.

items.zh: 关税可能保护生产者，却增加部分消费者成本。
items.en: Tariffs can protect producers while raising some consumer costs.
answers: Tariffs can protect producers while raising some consumer costs.

items.zh: 进口依赖的风险取决于替代来源是否存在。
items.en: Import dependence is riskier when alternative sources are unavailable.
answers: Import dependence is riskier when alternative sources are unavailable.

items.zh: 出口增长需要稳定的物流支持。
items.en: Export growth requires dependable logistics.
answers: Export growth requires dependable logistics.

items.zh: 贸易收益可能在行业之间分配不均。
items.en: Trade benefits can be distributed unevenly across sectors.
answers: Trade benefits can be distributed unevenly across sectors.

items.zh: 共同标准可以减少重复检测，但小型出口商可能需要支持才能支付认证费用。
items.en: Common standards can reduce duplicate testing, but small exporters may need help with certification costs.
answers: Common standards can reduce duplicate testing, but small exporters may need help with certification costs.
items.notes: duplicate testing：重复检测；certification costs：认证费用。

items.zh: 低价进口不一定意味着生产条件令人满意。
items.en: Cheap imports do not establish satisfactory production conditions.
answers: Cheap imports do not establish satisfactory production conditions.
Cheap imports don't establish satisfactory production conditions.

items.zh: 贸易争端可能影响并未参与决策的工人。
items.en: Trade disputes can affect workers excluded from decision-making.
answers: Trade disputes can affect workers excluded from decision-making.

items.zh: 全球分工可以提高专业化程度，同时加深生产环节之间的依赖。
items.en: A global division of labour can increase specialisation while deepening dependence between production stages.
answers: A global division of labour can increase specialisation while deepening dependence between production stages.
items.notes: division of labour：分工；while 表示并存的影响。

items.zh: 单一港口中断可能影响远处工厂。
items.en: Disruption at one port can affect distant factories.
answers: Disruption at one port can affect distant factories.

items.zh: 储备库存需要与仓储成本权衡。
items.en: Reserve inventories must be weighed against storage costs.
answers: Reserve inventories must be weighed against storage costs.

items.zh: 供应商多元化不等于没有风险。
items.en: Supplier diversification does not eliminate risk.
answers: Supplier diversification does not eliminate risk.
Supplier diversification doesn't eliminate risk.

items.zh: 透明合同能明确延误责任。
items.en: Transparent contracts can clarify responsibility for delays.
answers: Transparent contracts can clarify responsibility for delays.

items.zh: 外包会转移任务，但不一定消除责任。
items.en: Outsourcing transfers tasks without necessarily removing responsibility.
answers: Outsourcing transfers tasks without necessarily removing responsibility.

items.zh: 企业需要了解直接供应商之外的环节。
items.en: Firms need visibility beyond their immediate suppliers.
answers: Firms need visibility beyond their immediate suppliers.

items.zh: 效率与应对中断的能力需要同时考虑。
items.en: Efficiency and resilience to disruption need joint consideration.
answers: Efficiency and resilience to disruption need joint consideration.

items.zh: 人才流动可以促进知识交流，同时也可能使某些地区出现技能短缺。
items.en: Talent mobility can facilitate knowledge exchange while leaving some regions short of skills.
answers: Talent mobility can facilitate knowledge exchange while leaving some regions short of skills.

items.zh: 海外资格未获认可会浪费已有技能。
items.en: Unrecognised overseas qualifications can leave existing skills unused.
answers: Unrecognised overseas qualifications can leave existing skills unused.

items.zh: 移民融入需要语言支持和就业机会。
items.en: Migrant integration needs language support and employment opportunities.
answers: Migrant integration needs language support and employment opportunities.

items.zh: 汇款能够支持家庭，却不能替代全部公共服务。
items.en: Remittances support families but cannot replace every public service.
answers: Remittances support families but cannot replace every public service.
Remittances support families but can't replace every public service.

items.zh: 移居海外的人可能通过远程指导继续支持家乡的专业网络。
items.en: People who move abroad may continue supporting professional networks at home through remote mentoring.
answers: People who move abroad may continue supporting professional networks at home through remote mentoring.
items.notes: at home 指原居国或家乡；through 表示支持方式。

items.zh: 短期签证会限制家庭作长期安排的能力。
items.en: Short-term visas can limit families' capacity for long-term planning.
answers: Short-term visas can limit families' capacity for long-term planning.
items.notes: short-term 与 long-term 对照两个时间尺度。

items.zh: 吸引人才的政策也应考虑本地培训。
items.en: Talent recruitment policies should also consider local training.
answers: Talent recruitment policies should also consider local training.

items.zh: 返回者可能把新经验带回原社区。
items.en: Returnees may bring new experience to their home communities.
answers: Returnees may bring new experience to their home communities.

items.zh: 共同语言能够降低沟通成本，但不消除文化差异。
items.en: A shared language lowers communication costs without erasing cultural differences.
answers: A shared language lowers communication costs without erasing cultural differences.

items.zh: 翻译应重视含义，而不是仅对应字词。
items.en: Translation should preserve meaning rather than merely match words.
answers: Translation should preserve meaning rather than merely match words.

items.zh: 优势语言可能挤压小语种的使用空间。
items.en: Dominant languages can narrow the space for minority languages.
answers: Dominant languages can narrow the space for minority languages.

items.zh: 跨国协议中，同一个术语可能在不同法律体系下产生不同义务。
items.en: In cross-border agreements, the same term may create different obligations under different legal systems.
answers: In cross-border agreements, the same term may create different obligations under different legal systems.
items.notes: under a legal system：在某法律体系下。

items.zh: 口音不应被自动等同于能力不足。
items.en: An accent should not be equated with limited ability.
answers: An accent should not be equated with limited ability.
An accent shouldn't be equated with limited ability.

items.zh: 学习当地语言可能让新来者参与非正式交流，而这种机会难以用考试分数衡量。
items.en: Learning the local language may open informal conversations to newcomers, an opportunity poorly captured by test scores.
answers: Learning the local language may open informal conversations to newcomers, an opportunity poorly captured by test scores.
items.notes: 同位语 an opportunity 说明难以量化的收益。

items.zh: 跨时区协作需要公平分担不便。
items.en: Work across time zones requires fair sharing of inconvenience.
answers: Work across time zones requires fair sharing of inconvenience.

items.zh: 直接表达在不同文化中可能被不同解读。
items.en: Direct expression can be interpreted differently across cultures.
answers: Direct expression can be interpreted differently across cultures.

items.zh: 国际旅游使地方经济接触新的需求。
items.en: International tourism exposes local economies to new demand.
answers: International tourism exposes local economies to new demand.

items.zh: 游客支出不一定留在目的地社区。
items.en: Tourist spending does not necessarily stay in destination communities.
answers: Tourist spending does not necessarily stay in destination communities.
Tourist spending doesn't necessarily stay in destination communities.

items.zh: 文化展示可能在市场压力下被简化。
items.en: Cultural presentations may be simplified under market pressure.
answers: Cultural presentations may be simplified under market pressure.

items.zh: 旅游淡季会影响临时工的收入稳定。
items.en: Tourism's low season affects temporary workers' income stability.
answers: Tourism's low season affects temporary workers' income stability.

items.zh: 目的地推广应尊重当地居民的生活。
items.en: Destination promotion should respect residents' everyday lives.
answers: Destination promotion should respect residents' everyday lives.

items.zh: 旅游限制需要说明实施依据。
items.en: Tourism restrictions need a clear rationale.
answers: Tourism restrictions need a clear rationale.

items.zh: 远程地区可能承担较高的接待成本。
items.en: Remote destinations may bear high visitor-management costs.
answers: Remote destinations may bear high visitor-management costs.

items.zh: 交流的质量比短暂停留的数量更难衡量。
items.en: Exchange quality is harder to measure than brief visit counts.
answers: Exchange quality is harder to measure than brief visit counts.

items.zh: 跨境问题难以由单个国家独自解决。
items.en: Cross-border problems resist purely national solutions.
answers: Cross-border problems resist purely national solutions.

items.zh: 共同规则需要可信的执行机制。
items.en: Shared rules require credible enforcement mechanisms.
answers: Shared rules require credible enforcement mechanisms.

items.zh: 资源较少的国家也应参与规则制定。
items.en: Less-resourced countries should participate in rule-making.
answers: Less-resourced countries should participate in rule-making.

items.zh: 协议签署不等于国内执行已经完成。
items.en: Signing an agreement does not complete domestic implementation.
answers: Signing an agreement does not complete domestic implementation.
Signing an agreement doesn't complete domestic implementation.

items.zh: 长期合作需要处理利益不对称。
items.en: Lasting cooperation needs to address asymmetric interests.
answers: Lasting cooperation needs to address asymmetric interests.

items.zh: 技术标准可能影响谁能进入市场。
items.en: Technical standards can shape market access.
answers: Technical standards can shape market access.

items.zh: 知识产权规则需要考虑不同发展阶段。
items.en: Intellectual property rules should consider differing development stages.
answers: Intellectual property rules should consider differing development stages.

items.zh: 争端处理程序应对弱势参与者可用。
items.en: Dispute procedures need to be accessible to weaker participants.
answers: Dispute procedures need to be accessible to weaker participants.

items.zh: 援助项目需要适应接受方的制度能力。
items.en: Aid projects need to match recipients' institutional capacity.
answers: Aid projects need to match recipients' institutional capacity.

items.zh: 外部设备如果无法维修，长期价值可能有限。
items.en: Imported equipment has limited value if it cannot be maintained.
answers: Imported equipment has limited value if it cannot be maintained.
Imported equipment has limited value if it can't be maintained.

items.zh: 让当地居民参与选择供水地点，有助于识别外部规划者忽略的步行负担。
items.en: Involving residents in choosing water-supply locations can reveal walking burdens overlooked by outside planners.
answers: Involving residents in choosing water-supply locations can reveal walking burdens overlooked by outside planners.
items.notes: involve ... in：让……参与；overlooked 限定被忽略的负担。

items.zh: 短期交付数量不能完整证明发展成效。
items.en: Short-term delivery counts cannot fully demonstrate development outcomes.
answers: Short-term delivery counts cannot fully demonstrate development outcomes.
Short-term delivery counts can't fully demonstrate development outcomes.

items.zh: 资金承诺应与实际到账区分开。
items.en: Funding pledges should be distinguished from actual disbursements.
answers: Funding pledges should be distinguished from actual disbursements.

items.zh: 援助退出需要考虑服务能否持续。
items.en: Aid withdrawal must consider whether services can continue.
answers: Aid withdrawal must consider whether services can continue.

items.zh: 跨国伙伴应分享知识，而不只是分配任务。
items.en: International partners should share knowledge, not merely allocate tasks.
answers: International partners should share knowledge, not merely allocate tasks.

items.zh: 接受方应有空间调整不合适的方案。
items.en: Recipients need room to adapt unsuitable proposals.
answers: Recipients need room to adapt unsuitable proposals.

items.zh: 全球趋势会通过当地条件产生不同结果。
items.en: Global trends produce different outcomes through local conditions.
answers: Global trends produce different outcomes through local conditions.

items.zh: 本地特色可以在跨境交流中发展。
items.en: Local identities can evolve through international exchange.
answers: Local identities can evolve through international exchange.

items.zh: 统一模式可能忽略重要的地区差别。
items.en: Uniform models can overlook significant regional differences.
answers: Uniform models can overlook significant regional differences.

items.zh: 全球品牌也需要理解本地习惯。
items.en: Global brands also need to understand local practices.
answers: Global brands also need to understand local practices.

items.zh: 连接更紧密不意味着利益完全一致。
items.en: Closer connections do not mean identical interests.
answers: Closer connections do not mean identical interests.
Closer connections don't mean identical interests.

items.zh: 数字联系不能完全替代面对面理解。
items.en: Digital connections cannot wholly replace face-to-face understanding.
answers: Digital connections cannot wholly replace face-to-face understanding.
Digital connections can't wholly replace face-to-face understanding.

items.zh: 国际经验应经过评估后用于本地。
items.en: International experience needs appraisal before local application.
answers: International experience needs appraisal before local application.

items.zh: 一个国家可以保持贸易开放，同时为关键物资保留多种采购渠道。
items.en: A country can remain open to trade while retaining several procurement channels for essential supplies.
answers: A country can remain open to trade while retaining several procurement channels for essential supplies.
items.notes: while 表示两个目标可以并行；procurement：采购。
